caption:
How do you stop {team} {season_short}?

I turned their season into a graph of how the ball moves between pitch zones, then removed one link at a time and re-solved it.

The link that costs them most: {from_label} → {to_label}. Cut it and their threat falls {lo:.0%} if they adapt, up to {hi:.0%} if they keep losing the ball there.

Checked against 5,456 real team-matches: the half-space-to-centre links are worth 12-14% of threat for an average team, as the model says. How much MORE one team depends on a link than another is still untested.
